data.title: Bitcoin Core Contributor Identifies Privacy Flaw That Could Link BTC Wallet Address to Your Computer’s IP
data.description: A Bitcoin Core contributor flagged a vulnerability on Wednesday, November 25, that could expose the internet address of someone using a Bitcoin wallet.
